dimensions.definition: Maximum fraction of scenarios allowed to have R_selected < R_LOCAL after the frozen Gate-1.
dimensions.engineering_implication: A lower cap rejects more B2 substitutions even when average gain is positive.
dimensions.possible_policy: choose a pre-registered fraction in [0, 1]; do not copy 3/64 or 0.047

dimensions.definition: Most negative allowed R_selected - R_LOCAL on any retained scenario.
dimensions.engineering_implication: A tighter floor can fail the current Gate-1 even if mean gain remains positive.
dimensions.possible_policy: choose a pre-registered lower bound; do not copy -0.214

dimensions.definition: Whether the mean of R_selected - R_LOCAL must satisfy a pre-registered inequality.
dimensions.engineering_implication: A numeric floor is a project policy, not a statistic of the current 64 scenarios.

dimensions.definition: Whether mean selected U_traj must beat LOCAL, optionally by a pre-specified margin.
dimensions.engineering_implication: Utility-margin policy is independent of the current 1.081e7 vs 9.469e6 observation.

dimensions.definition: Whether any individual scenario may be worse than LOCAL after the gate.
dimensions.engineering_implication: forbid_all is stricter than C1/C2 and would fail any remaining B2-used degradation.

dimensions.definition: strict: for every scenario R_selected >= R_LOCAL; aggregate: only summary statistics must pass.
dimensions.engineering_implication: Strict non-inferiority forbids the current 3 Gate-1 degradations if they remain after audit.

dimensions.definition: Whether a second unseen batch, not 220000-220063, must also be evaluated against the same criterion.
dimensions.engineering_implication: If required, planner_ready stays false until a new unseen batch is generated and audited.

dimensions.definition: How many independent batches must pass, and whether each batch must be generated independently.
dimensions.engineering_implication: Repeated-batch policy is a project risk decision, not something the current 64 can decide.
dimensions.possible_policy: required_batch_count is a human integer or null; each batch must be independently generated if required

frozen_gate.rule: if margin >= tau: use B2 else LOCAL

next_audit_after_human_spec.procedure: After a human writes non-null acceptance fields, re-score the same frozen 64-scenario Gate-1 table against those fields. Do not search thresholds on that table. Do not enter Phase-4E until the audit is requested.

observed_reference.definition: if margin >= tau: B2 else LOCAL
observed_reference.disclaimer: These are observed evaluation results and are NOT deployment acceptance criteria.
